Ghoṣā
------------------------------------------
Out of the 27 brahmavādinīs (women seers) mentioned in the Ṛgveda, घोषा is also one. Two entire hymns of the tenth मण्डल (39 and 40) are her contribution. Her grandfather was the sage Dīrgha-तमस् and Kakṣīvān was her ड़थेर्.
The story goes that she was a victim of a fell disease because of which she had to remain in her ड़थेर्’s होउसे and unmarried. As she was getting old there, she decided to pray to the twin gods, the अश्विन्स् who were known as divine physicians endowed with the power of rejuvenation. The hymns 39 and 40 of the tenth मण्डल are her prayers. Pleased with her earnest entreaties, the अश्विन्स् granted her youth and a worthy husband. Her son Suhāsya is the ṛṣi or the sage of the next hymn, the 41st.
